---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem statement
What use case does this feature address? What is painful today?

## Proposed solution
How should this work?

## Alternatives considered
What other approaches did you consider, and why are they less suitable?

## Compatibility with Yagura's principles
- [ ] Preserves zero-dependency rule (or new dep is justified)
- [ ] Does not violate "read-default, write-explicit"
- [ ] Does not add multi-tenant complexity
